purpose: Predictive generalization gate for the V4.1 compact head-specific surrogate. It is scored once against the brand-new independent Locked evaluation (v4.1_locked) and is the ONLY gate that may authorize the next-round closed loop. It never reinterprets the V4.0 offline integrity gate and never lifts the deferred Model Safety Gate.

controls: authorization to plan the next-round Exact closed loop (PlanExactClosedLoopV4)
does_not_control: any modification of the original 1600 labels, margins, dead-zones or splits

underpowered_policy.trigger_when: insufficient positive class support or fewer than min_feasible_states feasible states
actions: do not change any threshold in this contract
do not delete or relabel the original v4.1_locked events

verdict_semantics.pass: every continuous / classification / ranking / calibration condition holds; authorizes_closed_loop=true
verdict_semantics.underpowered: power-limited (support/feasible states) but no hard scientific failure; authorizes_closed_loop=false
verdict_semantics.scientific_fail: at least one hard condition (continuous r2 positive, beat mean baseline, false-safe within limit, mcc positive) fails; authorizes_closed_loop=false

pre_execution_checks: locked result does not yet exist
evaluation data not read before intent is written

prohibitions: must not overwrite or restate the V4.0 offline gate as a predictive pass
must not use the old Calibration or old Locked as inputs
must not use new Locked results to retrain, re-select features, or re-tune thresholds and keep the same version
must not relax any threshold in this contract after the new Locked is read
must not authorize Exact/Surrogate/GAT closed loop, Policy Lock, Challenge or Formal Blind unless verdict=pass
